extDescription.message: A friendly shortcut coach that gently shows the keyboard shortcut when you do something with the mouse.

cardReminder.message: Looks like you're back to the mouse.

cardGmailNote.message: Turn on Settings > Keyboard shortcuts in Gmail first.

cardMuted.message: I won't hint this shortcut anymore.

cardMutedHint.message: Turn it back on from the toolbar icon → Settings.

learnedText.message: I won't remind you about this one anymore.

toastHintWin.message: Press Alt+Shift+P to turn them on or off.

toastHintMac.message: Press Option+Shift+P to turn them on or off.

tabSiteOff.message: Hints for $SITE$ are turned off in settings.

tabUnsupported.message: This site isn't supported yet. I work on YouTube, Gmail and Google Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides.

popObserving.message: At first I only watch your usual habits. I'll start after $COUNT$ more actions.

popWaiting.message: $COUNT$ more shortcuts are waiting for another day.

popLearnedEmpty.message: None yet. Press a shortcut once and it shows up here!

privateNote.message: These records are saved only in your Chrome on this computer, so only you can see them. Nothing is sent to your organization or anyone else.

colLead.message: Every shortcut you've pressed, grouped by service.

strengthGentleDesc.message: From the 5th time, up to 2 new shortcuts a day

strengthNormalDesc.message: From the 3rd time, up to 3 new shortcuts a day

strengthActiveDesc.message: Every time an action has a shortcut

popLogHint.message: Your last 10 actions, and why a hint did or didn't show.

whyNew.message: Hinted this shortcut for the first time.

whyReminder.message: You went back to the mouse, so I reminded you.

whyLearnedNow.message: You used the shortcut. It's learned now!

whyMuted.message: You stopped hints for this shortcut.

whyObserving.message: Just watching at first. Hints start after $COUNT$ more actions.

whyLearned.message: You already use this shortcut, so no hint.

whyRepeatWait.message: Already hinted. It can come up again from $TIME$.

whyBelowThreshold.message: Hints start at use number $NEED$ (this was number $COUNT$).

whyDailyCap.message: Already hinted $COUNT$ new shortcuts today. More tomorrow.

whyGap.message: Hints are at least a minute apart. Try again after $TIME$.

whyNewWaiting.message: Gave a waiting new shortcut its turn first.

tabMissing.message: This tab: working on $SITE$, but some buttons weren't found ($NAMES$). The site may have changed.

popMutedEmpty.message: None. Shortcuts you stop from a hint card show up here.

popRecordsHint.message: Only action names and counts are saved on this device. Nothing you type and no document content is saved.

popResetConfirm.message: Delete all saved records? This can't be undone.

popToggleWin.message: Turn hints on or off: Alt+Shift+P

popToggleMac.message: Turn hints on or off: Option+Shift+P

welLead.message: When something you do with the mouse has a shortcut, I'll show it in the bottom-right corner.

welHow1.message: For the first 30 actions I only watch. I skip shortcuts you already know.

welHow2.message: When you repeat an action with the mouse, I show its shortcut.

welHow3.message: Once a shortcut is second nature, I stop mentioning it.

welRec2.message: Whether you used the mouse or a shortcut

welStore.message: Records stay on this device and are never sent anywhere. Only settings sync across your devices through Chrome sync. Click the icon any time to view or delete records.

welSites.message: For now I work on YouTube, Gmail and Google Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides.

welToggleWin.message: Press Alt+Shift+P any time to turn hints on or off.

welToggleMac.message: Press Option+Shift+P any time to turn hints on or off.

welDone.message: Work on YouTube, Gmail or Google Calendar, Drive and Docs as usual.

welError.message: Couldn't save your settings. Reload Quickhand at chrome://extensions and try again.
